summary: 2.0.0 (6 Jul 2026): prefix cache works with speculation on hybrid models.

facts.text: 2.0.0 (6 Jul 2026): prefix cache works with speculation on hybrid models.
2.9.2: agent transcripts pass through unmodified by default.
2.11 (4 Sep 2026): same-origin local server, no dead time between tool turns, flash-decoding verify.
2.12.1 (2 Oct 2026): memory guard rewritten. 2.12.2 (3 Oct 2026): prompts priced per model for 8, 16 and 32 GB Macs.
A request that would exceed the memory limit is refused with a structured 507 before prefill instead of swapping the Mac toward a panic.
Codex sends a hosted `web_search` tool by default; MTPLX returns a precise 400 unless it is removed.
Non-zero presence or frequency penalties change the sampled distribution, so exactness holds only at the default of 0 (inferred from the README's "exact no-op" wording).
Cache keys for vision turns come from the image bytes so one image never reads another's cache.

MTPLX says output is exact at any temperature; Gemma and Qwen tests elsewhere (existing dossier) show multi-token verify differs from single-token at near-ties. MTPLX reports max_diff = 0.0 and token-id equality per release; independent confirmation is absent.
Whether concurrent clients batch speculative decoding or serialize (docs/concurrency.md was not fetched).
Independent reproduction of the exactness claim.
MTPLX's verify step evaluates all K drafted positions in one batched target forward using GraphBank-compiled verify shapes.
MTPLX decides acceptance with the probability ratio in an fp32 path because bf16 underflows, and rejected drafts never enter committed history.

MTPLX's committed-history KV contract was verified against a reference at cosine above 0.9998 through depth 5, and its quoted exactness check is max_diff = 0.0 against single-token autoregressive decoding.
MTPLX's acceptance by draft position on Qwen 3.6 27B at depth 4 (192-token coding bench, temperature 0.6, 28 Apr 2026) was 97.62%, 95.24%, 88.10% and 75.61%.

MTPLX builds on an MLX source fork (mlx-mtplx-0.31.2-qmm) with a retuned small-M qmv (BN16, 4 simdgroups, unroll_count 4) for verify shapes M=3..6, a fused GDN verify kernel built from the conv tape, and a draft-only 4- or 3-bit LM head.
MTPLX's SessionBank keeps a warm-prefix exact state, and the quoted check is logits_max_abs_diff = 0.0 across turns.
The MTPLX server also exposes `/v1/responses` (stateless, text-only, for Codex), `/v1/completions`, `/health` and `/metrics`, plus optional `/v1/embeddings` and `/v1/rerank`.

MTPLX answers Codex's default hosted `web_search` tool with a 400 unless the tool is removed, and resolves `reasoning.effort: "xhigh"` per model (Qwen 3.8 keeps it, Step 3.5 clamps to high, Qwen 3.6 has no tier).
`mtplx start` attaches to the app's already-running model rather than loading a second copy.

MTPLX serves embedding and reranker models from the same daemon with `--embedding-model` and `--reranker-model`; they bypass the MTP path, load on first request, are capped by `--retrieval-max-resident` (default 2), and checkpoints with bundled Python code get a 403 unless `--retrieval-trust-remote-code` is set.
MTPLX keeps `/v1/models` chat-only by default and lists retrieval models via `?capability=embedding` or `?capability=rerank`.
Presence and frequency penalties default to 0, an exact no-op that preserves MTP exactness; the README says to leave them at 0 for coding and agent work.
A default-on SSD session cache restores sessions across restarts (`--ssd-session-cache off` disables it); on 2.11.3 a 96,760-token conversation restored in 8 ms in the app.
MTPLX 2.11.3 reports a stop-and-resend reuse of 10,918 of 10,928 prompt tokens, and a save to SSD that yields to a waiting request in under 200 ms.
MTPLX 2.11 reports a tool turn after a file write re-prefills 20 tokens in 0.12 s instead of 3,535 tokens in 3.7 s, and a forced tool round in a 41k session drops from two cold re-prefills to 0.58 s.
Since MTPLX 2.9.2 the agent server no longer compacts tool results, trims file reads or injects steering text unless a rewrite is explicitly enabled.
MTPLX 2.9.2 turns chained greedy drafting on by default at temperature 0 under 12k context, measured +2.5 to +9.8% across 0.5k-8k prompts.
MTPLX 2.11 makes the local server same-origin by default, removes the API key from URLs and logs, and fixes prompts past 32k failing with HTTP 500 on macOS 27 betas.

MTPLX 2.12.1 rewrote the memory guard to price every request at its largest moment, release idle conversations before refusing, and name what holds the memory; the default memory limit became 90 GiB on 128 GB Macs and `--memory-limit max` uses everything outside macOS's reserve.
MTPLX refuses a request that would cross the memory limit with a structured HTTP 507 before prefill, instead of swapping the Mac toward a panic.
MTPLX 2.12.2 (3 Oct 2026) prices each prompt at its measured use (0.19 GiB for a 59-token prompt on the 4B instead of the 27B's 3 GiB chunk) and retries in 1,024 or 512-token chunks before refusing.
MTPLX 2.8 stopped long sessions silently losing prompt-cache reuse near 38k tokens by advancing the committed frontier on every turn, tool-call turns included.
MTPLX `/health` reports degradation such as compiled-verify fallbacks, overridden profile keys and kernel bails, and `mtplx_stats` is always populated.
MTPLX records a per-second flight-recorder log per request and `mtplx trace` turns a coding session into a diagnosis report, local-only at a few MB a day.
Fan-backed MTPLX modes restore automatic fan control through a detached watchdog even after `kill -9` or closing the terminal.
Using MTPLX in a shipped product requires an in-product "Powered by MTPLX" notice under the NOTICE file, beyond Apache-2.0's license text.
